title: QA Automation Tester (Selenium/Playwright)
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Location: Bengaluru, India

- Expertise in Automation Testing of Web based applications
- Good experience in building and using automation frameworks using technologies: Java/ C#.
- Experience in doing in-sprint automation.
- Strong Automation background with experience in identifying and reviewing test cases and testing results.
- Ability to understand complex requirements and transform those into Test Scenarios, Test cases and Test Scripts.
- Proficient in Version Control tool (ex: GIT )
- Worked on automating the CI/CD pipelines.
- Good Knowledge of Manual Testing of Web and Windows-based applications.

description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities. 

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. 

We are seeking a highly skilled Wireless Test Engineer with 6-8 years of experience in wireless networking, quality assurance, and test automation. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) and Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) technologies, enterprise wireless solutions, and end-to-end quality validation.

In this role, you will lead the design and execution of comprehensive test strategies, drive automation initiatives, and validate the performance, scalability, interoperability, and reliability of wireless networking products. You will leverage strong programming skills, particularly in Python, along with experience using VeriWave or similar traffic generation tools to assess wireless network performance under real-world and high-scale conditions.

As a technical leader, you will provide guidance and mentorship to QA engineers, contribute to troubleshooting complex wireless networking issues, and partner closely with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality, enterprise-grade wireless solutions.

Key Qualifications

- 6-8 years of experience in Wireless QA, Network Testing, or Quality Engineering.

- Strong expertise in Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), and IEEE 802.11 standards.

- Hands-on experience testing enterprise Wireless Access Points (APs) and Wireless Controllers.

- Solid understanding of wireless networking concepts including WPA2/WPA3, 802.1X, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, QoS, and TCP/IP.

- Experience performing wireless performance, capacity, scalability, and interoperability testing using VeriWave or equivalent traffic-generation platforms.

- Strong programming and test automation skills using Python, with experience in frameworks such as PyTest or Robot Framework.

- Proficiency in Wireshark for packet analysis and troubleshooting.

- Working knowledge of Linux environments and shell scripting.

- Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex wireless networking issues.

- Prior experience leading QA initiatives, mentoring engineers, and driving high-quality project delivery.

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.

Software Quality Engineer (Automation, AI-Driven Testing)
 LOCATION: Hyderabad, India

 Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Quality Engineer with deep expertise in ATM applications, cheque processing, fintech systems, and modern automation frameworks, who can ensure high-quality delivery across ATM, switching, and digital banking ecosystems.
 This role requires a strong combination of:
 
 • Manual + Automation Testing + Hardware Testing
 • ATM and Banking Domain Expertise (Hardware + Transaction Flows)
 • AI-Assisted QA Practices (Copilot, Cursor)
 • Next-Generation Automation Frameworks such as Playwright
Must-Have (Technical Core)
 1. Automation framework architecture – proven experience designing/scaling test frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium) from scratch, not just using existing ones.
 2. Programming proficiency – strong in at least one of the automation scripting or coding languages (JS/TS, Python, Java) with clean, maintainable code practices.
 3. Test strategy & planning – ability to define test coverage strategy across E2E/regression layers, not just execution.
 4. CI/CD integration – hands-on experience embedding automated tests into pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

 High Priority (Leadership & Process)
 1. Risk-based prioritization – ability to identify high-risk areas and allocate automation effort accordingly.
 2. People/team leadership – experience managing or mentoring a QA team, conducting reviews, and upskilling engineers.
 3. Cross-functional collaboration – track record working closely with Dev, Product, and DevOps to shift testing left.

description:
About RocketlaneRocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery. Our product runs on a set of microservices that power projects, resourcing, time tracking, billing and a customer-facing portal. We're also building Nitro, an AI-native layer where Nitro agents do real delivery work for our customers.
We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test who can test both: the core platform, and the GenAI and agentic features we build on top of it.
This is not a "run the regression suite and file tickets" role. You'll own quality for the areas you cover, from functional testing to automation to release sign-off.
What you'll own- Functional testing: Understand features end to end, from requirements to edge cases. Write test plans and test cases, and run exploratory testing before every release.

- UI and end-to-end automation: Build and maintain Playwright suites in TypeScript for critical user journeys. Keep them fast, stable and free of flaky tests.

- API and microservices testing: Test REST APIs and the contracts between services. Cover authentication, permissions, data validation and error handling.

- Distributed systems testing: Test asynchronous flows, background jobs and event-driven workflows across services. Check for data consistency, retries, idempotency and behaviour when a downstream service fails or slows down.

- Performance and reliability: Run load and performance tests on key services and workflows. Find bottlenecks before customers do.

- GenAI and agentic testing: Test Nitro agents and other GenAI features for accuracy, consistency and safe behaviour. Build eval suites, curate test datasets from real scenarios, and check tool-use accuracy and handoff to humans.

- CI/CD and release quality: Wire automated suites into CI so every change is checked before it ships. Provide quality sign-off for the areas you cover.

- Frameworks and documentation: Enhance our existing test frameworks and tools. Document test strategies, test cases and guidelines for the team.

Requirements- 4–7 years in software testing and test automation for web applications

- Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Java or Python for test automation

- Solid programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design, applied to writing clean, maintainable test code

- Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for UI and end-to-end testing, including building and maintaining a framework

- Strong functional testing skills: breaking down requirements, writing test cases and finding edge cases

- Experience testing REST APIs and microservices, including service-to-service contracts

- A good understanding of distributed systems: async processing, queues or events, eventual consistency and partial failures, and how to test for them

- Exposure to testing GenAI or agentic features, and an understanding of how they fail (hallucination, non-deterministic output, tool misuse)

- CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Daily use of AI coding agents, and the judgement to review the test code they write

- Excellent written communication: bug reports an engineer can act on without a meeting

Nice to have- Experience with an LLM eval framework (such as DeepEval, Promptfoo or RAGAS)

- Load testing experience (k6, Locust or similar)

- Security testing experience, including for AI applications

Why this roleYou'll join a team that already tests and automates our platform and AI features, and help raise the bar as both grow. You'll work across the full product: core workflows, the services behind them, and the Nitro agents built on top. You'll work directly with the engineers and PMs building them, and your quality sign-off is a key input to every release. If you want to grow from strong product testing into AI testing, this role is for you.

**Role Summary**

Build and own the automation framework and regression suite that decides whether a release reaches production, with real authority to stop a deployment. This is an engineering role, not manual testing with some Selenium attached: you join the design conversation and test for logical failures, not just visual ones.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Framework:** API and UI automation built as a codebase with the same standards as the product.
* **Regression suite:** Fast enough that people run it and trustworthy enough that a red build means something.
* **Release gating:** Define and enforce pre-production validation and criteria for going to production.
* **Contract and integration tests:** Across services and across the boundary with connected organisations.
* **Quality signal:** Defect triage, coverage and escape metrics that leadership can act on.
* **Testing blind:** Design test data, fixtures and failure diagnosis that work without reading personal data payloads.
* **Proving a negative:** Test that an append-only, tamper-evident consent ledger cannot be quietly subverted.
* **Withdrawal propagation:** Verify across a distributed system, including failure paths, that a withdrawal reaches every connected organisation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 years building test automation as software, or 3 years with an advanced degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* Has designed an automation framework from scratch, not only written tests inside someone elses.
* Strong programming in Python, TypeScript or Java.
* Playwright, Cypress or Selenium at depth, and API testing with RestAssured, Postman/Newman or equivalent.
* Tests wired into CI as a gate that can genuinely block a release.
* Test design as a discipline: risk-based coverage, boundary and negative cases, and judgement on what not to automate.
* Hands-on use of AI-assisted testing tools for authoring, maintenance or coverage analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Contract testing between services (Pact or equivalent).
* Performance and load testing with JMeter, k6 or Locust.
* Security testing fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation edge cases, injection paths.
* Mobile test automation, ideally Flutter.

B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in CS/IT, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Senior Quality Assurance Engineer**

  

* The **Senior Software Engineer Quality Assurance & Agentic AI** is a high-impact technical contributor responsible for designing and building advanced quality engineering frameworks, developer self-service test automation APIs, test orchestration middleware and intelligent, Agentic AI-driven quality tools.
* Unlike a conventional QA engineer focused primarily on executing test cases or maintaining individual automation scripts, this engineer builds scalable quality engineering capabilities that empower hundreds of digital engineering squads across Woolworths Group to build, validate, test and release software safely and rapidly.
* The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and quality engineering expertise with hands-on experience designing and building **Agentic AI agents, custom LLM integrations and intelligent automation workflows** that transform how software quality is engineered across the organisation.

  

***Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position.***

  

**About this role**

  

The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer will play a pivotal role in advancing Woolworths Group's quality engineering ecosystem through scalable automation platforms, intelligent test orchestration and AI-powered engineering tools. You will design and develop reusable test automation frameworks, developer-facing APIs, middleware integrations and cloud-native test execution capabilities that enable engineering teams to validate software consistently and efficiently.

  

A key focus of this role is embedding Agentic AI into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). You will build intelligent agents and reusable skills that automate test-case generation, test execution, pull-request analysis, code quality validation, security checks and defect triage. Working closely with software engineering, platform engineering, security and quality engineering teams, you will help establish next-generation quality engineering practices and enable continuous, automated quality validation at enterprise scale.

  

**What youll do**

* **Quality Engineering Frameworks:** Design, develop and evolve scalable test automation frameworks and reusable testing components for UI, API, microservices and distributed applications using Java, Python, Go, Playwright, Selenium or Cypress.
* **Developer Self-Service Automation:** Build developer-facing test automation APIs, SDKs, CLI utilities and reusable quality tools that allow engineering squads to independently create, execute and manage automated tests.
* **Agentic AI Engineering:** Design, build and integrate AI agents, agent skills and custom LLM-powered workflows into the SDLC to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
* **AI-Powered Quality Automation:** Develop intelligent agents for automated test generation and execution, pull-request analysis, code review, defect classification, failure triage, code quality assessment and security validation.
* **Test Orchestration & Infrastructure:** Build test orchestration middleware and distributed execution capabilities to coordinate automated test runs across containerised environments and multiple engineering services.
* **API & Contract Testing:** Develop robust API and contract testing capabilities, including integration with tools and standards such as REST, OpenAPI and Pact.
* **Cloud-Native Test Environments:** Design and manage dynamic, containerised test execution environments using Docker and Kubernetes, including service mocking, service virtualisation and environment provisioning.
* **CI/CD & Quality Gates:** Integrate automated testing, code coverage, vulnerability scanning and quality validation into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps.
* **Developer Tooling & Integrations:** Build reusable engineering utilities, custom pipeline integrations, quality dashboards and developer productivity tools that simplify testing and improve visibility into software quality.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Use Terraform or OpenTofu to provision and manage test environments, mock environments and supporting infrastructure.
* **Engineering Excellence:** Establish standards for automation architecture, code quality, test reliability, maintainability, observability and secure software delivery.
* **Technical Collaboration:** Partner with engineering squads and stakeholders across Australia and India to identify quality engineering challenges, drive adoption of reusable solutions and continuously improve software delivery practices.

  

**What youll bring**

* **Career Trajectory:** Typically 6-10 years of strong hands-on software engineering, quality engineering and automated testing systems design experience, with a proven track record of developing scalable automation frameworks, testing infrastructure or engineering tools.
* **Agentic AI & LLM Engineering:** Ideally 34 years of practical experience building and integrating AI agents, custom LLM solutions and intelligent workflows into software development and quality engineering processes. Hands-on agent development is essential; simply using AI coding assistants or ChatGPT for test generation will not be sufficient.
* **Test Automation & Quality Engineering:** Strong experience designing, developing or significantly extending scalable test automation frameworks using Java, Python, Go, Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar technologies across UI, API and microservices testing.
* **Advanced API & Contract Testing:** Hands-on experience with REST API testing, service integration testing, contract testing and tools such as Pact, alongside a sound understanding of distributed application architectures.
* **Agentic AI for Quality Engineering:** Demonstrated ability to build AI agents and automated workflows for test-case generation, automated test execution, pull-request reviews, code quality validation, defect triage and security checks.
* **Programming & Developer Tooling:** Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go or Node.js/TypeScript, with experience developing reusable libraries, developer tooling, CLI utilities, automation services or custom integrations.
* **Containerisation & Orchestration:** Production-grade experience with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS or equivalent), including dynamic test environment provisioning, distributed test execution, service mocking and service virtualisation.
* **CI/CD & Quality Gates:** Hands-on experience designing and integrating automated testing and quality gates into GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps pipelines. Familiarity with code coverage, SonarQube, security vulnerability scanning and tools such as Snyk is expected.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Basic to intermediate hands-on experience with Terraform or OpenTofu for provisioning test environments and supporting infrastructure.
* **Engineering Quality & Security:** Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, test reliability, secure coding, automated quality validation and production-readiness standards.

  

**Desirable / Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or Semantic Kernel, vector databases such as Pinecone or ChromaDB, and LLM evaluation techniques.
* Experience with MCP-based integrations, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent guardrails and autonomous engineering workflows.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as K6 and JMeter, visual regression testing and chaos engineering.
* Experience developing custom GitHub Actions, reusable CI/CD plugins, IDE extensions or VS Code extensions.
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows using ArgoCD or Flux.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Kubernetes Gateway API and network-level traffic mirroring.
* Exposure to SRE concepts, SLIs/SLOs, synthetic monitoring and observability platforms such as Sentry or Datadog.
* Experience building internal quality engineering platforms or developer tooling adopted by multiple engineering teams.

**JD NPI & Test Automation Engineer (Electronics / Power Systems)**

**Role summary**

The engineer owns NPI support, hardware validation and automated test system development for telecom power products, EV DC chargers and Li-ion battery packs. The role bridges R&D and production: it turns new designs into tested, production-ready products and builds the test setups that cut test time and improve repeatability on the line.

**Key responsibilities**

**Automated test systems (ATS) and test jigs**

* Study schematics, rack architecture and engineering documents to define test and validation requirements.

* Assemble, wire and verify test setups, then validate them against manual testing before release to production.
* Develop Python applications for functional test cases, real-time monitoring, data logging and Excel/report generation.
* Design and maintain burn-in, life-cycle and regenerative test setups for batteries and SMRs.

title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------

Rocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery. Our product runs on a set of microservices that power projects, resourcing, time tracking, billing and a customer-facing portal. We're also building Nitro, an AI-native layer where Nitro agents do real delivery work for our customers.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test who can test both: the core platform, and the GenAI and agentic features we build on top of it.

This is not a "run the regression suite and file tickets" role. You'll own quality for the areas you cover, from functional testing to automation to release sign-off.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* *Functional testing:* Understand features end to end, from requirements to edge cases. Write test plans and test cases, and run exploratory testing before every release.
* *UI and end-to-end automation:* Build and maintain Playwright suites in TypeScript for critical user journeys. Keep them fast, stable and free of flaky tests.
* *API and microservices testing:* Test REST APIs and the contracts between services. Cover authentication, permissions, data validation and error handling.
* *Distributed systems testing:* Test asynchronous flows, background jobs and event-driven workflows across services. Check for data consistency, retries, idempotency and behaviour when a downstream service fails or slows down.
* *Performance and reliability:* Run load and performance tests on key services and workflows. Find bottlenecks before customers do.
* *GenAI and agentic testing:* Test Nitro agents and other GenAI features for accuracy, consistency and safe behaviour. Build eval suites, curate test datasets from real scenarios, and check tool-use accuracy and handoff to humans.
* *CI/CD and release quality:* Wire automated suites into CI so every change is checked before it ships. Provide quality sign-off for the areas you cover.
* *Frameworks and documentation:* Enhance our existing test frameworks and tools. Document test strategies, test cases and guidelines for the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 4–7 years in software testing and test automation for web applications
* Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Java or Python for test automation
* Solid programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design, applied to writing clean, maintainable test code
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for UI and end-to-end testing, including building and maintaining a framework
* Strong functional testing skills: breaking down requirements, writing test cases and finding edge cases
* Experience testing REST APIs and microservices, including service-to-service contracts
* A good understanding of distributed systems: async processing, queues or events, eventual consistency and partial failures, and how to test for them
* Exposure to testing GenAI or agentic features, and an understanding of how they fail (hallucination, non-deterministic output, tool misuse)
* CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar)
* Daily use of AI coding agents, and the judgement to review the test code they write
* Excellent written communication: bug reports an engineer can act on without a meeting

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with an LLM eval framework (such as DeepEval, Promptfoo or RAGAS)
* Load testing experience (k6, Locust or similar)
* Security testing experience, including for AI applications

**Why this role**
-----------------

You'll join a team that already tests and automates our platform and AI features, and help raise the bar as both grow. You'll work across the full product: core workflows, the services behind them, and the Nitro agents built on top. You'll work directly with the engineers and PMs building them, and your quality sign-off is a key input to every release. If you want to grow from strong product testing into AI testing, this role is for you.

title: Senior Engineer-QA and Customer Experience
description:
**Join Our Journey at VuNet**
=============================

We are looking for a **Senior Engineer – QA and Customer Experience** to drive the overall quality and customer experience of the **VuSmartMaps Observability Platform**.

This role goes beyond conventional testing. You will take ownership of validating the platform from an end-customer perspective, ensuring that its features, workflows, integrations and overall user experience meet the expectations of enterprise customers.

You will be responsible for defining test strategies, planning and executing comprehensive manual and exploratory testing, building effective automation suites, and validating the reliability and performance of a complex, distributed, cloud-native platform.

Working closely with Engineering, Product, SRE and DevOps teams, you will proactively identify product gaps, uncover real-world usage issues, and drive quality improvements across the entire product lifecycle.

**Your Role:** **Senior QA Engineer - QA and Customer Experience**
------------------------------------------------------------------

### **1. Test Strategy, Planning and Manual Verification**

* Own test strategy and planning for platform releases, features, enhancements and maintenance releases.
* Analyze product requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Plan and execute functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory and end-to-end testing.
* Design test data and test environments that represent realistic customer deployments and usage patterns.
* Validate complex workflows, configurations, integrations and feature interactions across different platform components.
* Identify edge cases, negative scenarios, failure conditions and potential product gaps through systematic exploratory testing.
* Maintain comprehensive test documentation, execution reports, defect reports and release sign-off criteria.

### **2. Customer Experience and End-to-End Product Validation**

* Validate VuSmartMaps from an end-customer perspective, focusing on usability, functional completeness, reliability and consistency.
* Simulate real-world customer deployment scenarios and validate complete user journeys rather than testing individual components in isolation.
* Validate installation, configuration, onboarding, upgrades, integrations, day-to-day operations and troubleshooting workflows.
* Identify usability issues, confusing workflows, configuration challenges and product behaviour that could negatively impact customer experience.
* Reproduce and investigate customer-reported issues, identify root causes and work with Engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Participate in release readiness assessments and ensure that product releases meet defined quality and customer acceptance standards.

### **3. Test Automation and AI-Assisted Testing**

* Design, develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration and regression testing.
* Build browser automation using **Playwright**, with hands-on experience in **Playwright MCP (Model Context Protocol)** being desirable.
* Develop test automation using Python, Go, Bash, pytest or similar technologies.
* Identify suitable test scenarios for automation and progressively improve regression coverage.
* Explore AI-assisted testing using LLMs, AI agents and intelligent testing workflows.
* Develop reusable AI skill definitions, prompts and workflows for test generation, execution, validation and defect analysis.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitOps, Spinnaker or similar platforms.

### **4. Performance, Reliability and Resilience Testing**

* Design and execute performance, load, stress and scalability tests for platform components and end-to-end workflows.
* Validate platform behaviour under high ingestion volumes, concurrent workloads and resource-constrained conditions.
* Evaluate system behaviour during component failures, service restarts, network disruptions and infrastructure failures.
* Exposure to chaos engineering and resilience testing practices is an added advantage.
* Collaborate with Engineering, SRE and DevOps teams to identify performance bottlenecks and reliability issues.

### **5. Collaboration and Quality Ownership**

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, SRE and DevOps teams throughout the product development and release lifecycle.
* Drive shift-left quality practices by participating in requirement reviews, design discussions and acceptance criteria definition.
* Provide actionable feedback to improve product functionality, usability and operational experience.
* Mentor team members and promote effective manual testing, automation and quality engineering practices.
* Take ownership of quality outcomes and continuously improve testing processes and release confidence.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
============================

* Own the end-to-end quality strategy for the VuSmartMaps Observability Platform.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for APIs, UI, distributed services, and telemetry pipelines.
* Build AI-assisted test automation using LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent testing workflows.
* Develop reusable **AI Skill Definitions**, prompts, and workflows for automated test generation, validation, and regression testing.
* Build browser automation using **Playwright**, with hands-on experience in **Playwright MCP (Model Context Protocol)** being highly desirable.
* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, performance, and resilience tests for distributed systems.
* Develop automation frameworks using **Playwright**, **Python, Go, Bash, pytest**.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitOps, Spinnaker, or similar platforms.
* Collaborate with Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to drive Shift-Left quality practices.
* Mentor QA engineers and promote automation and AI testing best practices.

**What You Bring**
==================

### **Required Skills**

* 4–7 years of experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering or product testing.
* Strong hands-on experience in **manual testing, test strategy, test planning and exploratory testing**.
* Ability to understand complex product requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Experience in validating enterprise applications, end-to-end workflows, APIs and integrations.
* Practical experience with UI and API test automation.
* Hands-on experience with **Playwright** or similar modern browser automation frameworks.
* Proficiency in Python, Go, Bash or similar scripting/programming languages.
* Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and a customer-centric approach to product validation.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate across teams and take ownership of quality deliverables.

### **Preferred skills**

* Experience testing Kubernetes-based, microservices-driven applications and distributed systems.
* Ability to get deep into understanding the product/application/platform under test and plan test strategies.
* Familiarity with Linux-based platform environments, shell commands, log analysis and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on exposure to Kubernetes, Docker and containerized application deployments.

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitOps and Spinnaker.
* Knowledge of observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Elasticsearch, Kafka and ClickHouse.

**What makes this role interesting?**
=====================================

**Job Purpose****:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to design and execute testing across our client’s SAP landscape and its integrations, working under the direction of the Test Manager. The immediate priority is the rehosting of the client’s SAP ECC environment to a new hosting provider, where you will carry out regression and end-to-end integration testing across SAP ECC, the MuleSoft integration layer and connected applications such as ServiceMax. The role offers continuity into the client’s SAP S/4HANA programme, expected to commence in 2027, and requires some overlap with UK business hours.

**Responsibilities****:**

  

* Contribute to the test plan defined by the Test Manager by analysing requirements, process flows and interface designs and identifying the business-critical scenarios for regression.
* Design and execute test scenarios for functional and end-to-end regression testing across **FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, PM, QM, CS, HR and PS-related processes**, covering Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Plan-to-Produce and Record-to-Report.
* Validate technical areas with BASIS and technical teams, including **BASIS, GRC, Access & Security and ABAP** custom developments, batch jobs, IDocs and printing.
* Test MuleSoft integrations and APIs between SAP and third-party applications such as ServiceMax, covering data mappings, error handling and post-rehost connectivity.
* Validate backend data using SQL and SAP table extracts, including pre- and post-cutover reconciliation.
* Execute SIT cycles with dependent teams, support UAT and business sign-off, and support cutover, smoke testing and hypercare.
* Log, triage and track defects to closure, and provide test progress, defect and risk updates to the Test Manager.
* Build reusable regression assets that carry forward into the client’s SAP S/4HANA programme.
* Coordinate with business users and SMEs for UAT preparation and execution, defect clarification, retesting and business sign-off, including tracking UAT dependencies, business-user participation and testing assumptions.
* Support estimation and planning of testing activities, timelines, dependencies and resource requirements across SIT, regression, UAT, cutover and hypercare phases
* Support the Test Manager in establishing and executing the test governance model, including test planning, entry/exit criteria, test execution tracking, defect governance, risk management, status reporting and stakeholder communication

**Qualifications, Skills and Experience****:**

* **Essential**
  + **8+ years** of experience in QA and software testing, including **5+ years** of **SAP ECC and S/4HANA testing.**
  + Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related discipline.
  + Strong knowledge of SAP business processes across **FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, PM, QM, CS and HR**, with a good understanding of **BASIS, GRC, Access & Security and ABAP**.
  + Hands-on experience validating SAP backend processing using transactions, tables, IDocs and batch job monitoring.
  + Proven experience testing MuleSoft integrations and REST/SOAP APIs using Anypoint Platform, Postman or SoapUI.
  + Proficiency in SQL for data validation and reconciliation.

**A Day in Your Life at MKS:**

* As a Senior Software and Firmware QA Engineer, you will work with global firmware, software, hardware, systems, application engineering, and product teams to ensure the quality of industrial controller products.
* You will combine hands-on system testing, test automation, defect investigation, and quality leadership across embedded firmware, software applications, communication interfaces, and hardware-software integration.
* Your work will include reviewing requirements, building risk-based test coverage, operating laboratory test setups, analyzing logs and traces, and providing clear release-quality recommendations.
* You will help improve test methods, automation, infrastructure, and engineering practices while mentoring QA engineers and driving issues to closure.

**You Will Make an Impact By:**

* Owning end-to-end software, firmware, and system validation activities, including test strategy, coverage, quality metrics, risk assessment, and release recommendations.
* Developing and executing test plans, test cases, and test procedures for embedded firmware, desktop applications, Windows- or Linux-based tools, APIs, services, user interfaces, and industrial control software.
* Performing functional, integration, system, regression, performance, reliability, compatibility, negative, and exploratory testing.
* Validating communication and interaction between software, firmware, hardware, and external devices.
* Designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks, reusable libraries, regression suites, and test-reporting solutions.
* Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improving automated build, execution, reporting, and traceability workflows.
* Identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, traces, and supporting evidence.
* Analyzing software logs, crash information, network traffic, protocol traces, hardware signals, and test results to isolate system-level failures.
* Maintaining QA environments, hardware-in-the-loop setups, simulators, automated fixtures, laboratory equipment, and test data.
* Collaborating with globally distributed development teams, communicating quality risks clearly, and mentoring QA engineers.

**Skills You Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in software QA, firmware QA, embedded-system validation, or system verification, including ownership of complex validation activities.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycle, requirement traceability, risk-based testing, and release-quality practices.
* Experience creating test strategies, test plans, test cases, test procedures, validation reports, quality metrics, and release summaries.
* Hands-on experience testing desktop, client-server, API, user-interface, embedded, or industrial control applications.
* Proficiency in Python, C#, or a similar programming language used for test automation.
* Experience developing maintainable automated test frameworks and integrating tests into CI/CD environments.
* Experience with API and UI testing tools such as Postman, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent tools.
* Experience analyzing logs, traces, crash data, network traffic, and system behavior to investigate complex failures.
* Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or comparable debugging equipment.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience testing embedded systems, real-time systems, and hardware-software integrated products.
* Experience with defect and requirements tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent systems.
* Experience with version control using Git and repository platforms such as GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent systems.

* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, DeviceNet, Modbus TCP.
* ISTQB Foundation, Advanced, Test Automation Engineer, or an equivalent software-testing certification.
